entities.name: PMID:25100161
observations: 2015 International Endodontic Journal study reports LL-37-induced VEGF expression in cultured human dental pulp cells, with ERK signaling implicated.

entities.name: LL-37 VEGF pulp cells
observations: In cultured human pulp cells, LL-37 (10 μg/mL) increased VEGF mRNA and protein (qPCR and ELISA; P<0.01), increased ERK1/2 phosphorylation, and ERK-kinase-inhibitor pretreatment suppressed phosphorylation and VEGF increases.

entities.name: LL-37
observations: Human cathelicidin peptide tested at 10 μg/mL in cultured dental pulp cells in PMID:25100161.

entities.name: HGNC:12680
observations: VEGFA/VEGF mRNA and protein increased following LL-37 treatment in cultured human dental pulp cells in PMID:25100161.

entities.name: ERK signaling
observations: LL-37 induced ERK1/2 phosphorylation; an ERK kinase inhibitor suppressed the phosphorylation and VEGF increase in cultured human dental pulp cells (PMID:25100161).
